name: wolfdris-highlight
description: Colours the Wolfdris wrapper library's names in Idris files, so Wolfram built-ins stand out.

wolfdris.highlight.enabled.description: Colour the names of the Wolfdris wrapper library in Idris files.

wolfdris.highlight.color.description: Colour of library names with a dark theme (CSS colour, e.g. #E8735A).

wolfdris.highlight.lightColor.description: Colour of library names with a light theme.

wolfdris.highlight.fontStyle.description: Extra style for library names, besides the colour.
